purpose: Bind Project Plugin/Programmeren to one live manifest, explicit source roles, evidence-backed controlled updates, and one canonical central GitHub plugin-audit harness. Reusable engineering method remains owned by wordpressqualityarchitect.

canonical_audit_harness.use_when: Explicit WordPress plugin test/audit request for an explicitly identified GitHub repository when the GitHub app can read the target and write the harness request file.
canonical_audit_harness.do_not_use_when: Ordinary repository inspection/advice, standalone ZIP/local/pasted code without a GitHub target, or a private target while the harness is public.
canonical_audit_harness.private_target_policy: blocked while harness visibility is public
canonical_audit_harness.run_correlation: Match the workflow run head_sha exactly to the request-write commit SHA.
canonical_audit_harness.evidence_boundary: A green harness run proves only the source/controlled-runtime layers actually executed; it is not staging, production, browser/device, provider or human accessibility proof.

workflow: read registered manifest and bootstrap sources
treat contract and evidence as non-policy roles
block owner, root, version or hash conflicts
use the canonical audit harness only when the operator contract conditions are satisfied
return continuation and completion evidence to webactueel-workflow
stop_conditions: private audit target while canonical harness is public
write without baseline, approval, backup or rollback
surface_rule: In normal ChatGPT Chat, CodeRabbit is never an active route. A proven GitHub app route may read the target and, for an explicit canonical plugin-audit request, write only the harness request file after target, rights and current blob SHA are verified. Only proven Work or Codex surfaces may consider CodeRabbit after repository, terminal and network preflight is ready.
